parsed.explanation: No documented trans-specific facility ban, birth-sex custody rule, bathroom exclusion or police sweep, and foreign passports are not shown to be rejected — so the worst tier-1 institutional exposures are absent. But the 2024 package is a state threat-framing regime: gender-identity 'promotion', gatherings and Pride are banned; transition care is prohibited outright; no recognition exists. Recourse is nominal only — hate-crime provisions and the 2014 discrimination law are documented as inefficient, with no statistics, 73% of victims not reporting and homophobic police reactions (2017 public defender findings). Anti-LGBTI assembly violence is a documented pattern (2012, 2013, 2021 — with victims arrested and bail refused), and a trans woman was stabbed to death the day after passage, plus spreading demonising misinformation. Violent societal hostility with effectively no remedy outweighs the absent facility rules; the 2012 prevalence survey is dated and LGBT-wide, so it is not weighted as current.
